# Copilot Repository Instructions

All instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root.
Follow it exactly. It holds the project overview, the hard rules and the working protocol, and it
points to the project memories in `.serena/memories/` (start with `core.md`). Those memories hold
the conventions, commands, definition of done and design notes.

This file is only a pointer. Do not add rules here; change `AGENTS.md` or the memories instead.
